recommendation: Keep the empty no-change audit commit. No core follow-up is needed unless FM reintroduces ProcessResponse or identifies an active FM resource that lacks the expected status element or status search parameter.
issue_request: FHIR-5440 is a Published FHIR-core/FM ProcessResponse ballot issue with Persuasive with Modification resolution. It asked that status be a property of the underlying resource and a status search parameter, with related concern that StatusRequest and StatusResponse should not exist as separate resources. The final resolution says status was already added to all FM resources for STU3.
initial_application: No FHIR-5440-tagged source commit was found. Git history shows StatusResponse was replaced by ProcessResponse in 2015, and commit e0b5e2fb33 in 2016 explicitly added status to EligibilityResponse, EnrollmentResponse, ProcessRequest, and ProcessResponse. The retained ProcessResponse spreadsheet source includes ProcessResponse.status and its status search-parameter row.
additional_context: The latest combined branch comments ProcessRequest and ProcessResponse out of the active source/fhir.ini resource and workgroup lists, lists ProcessResponse among removed resources, and records that ProcessResponse should use Task. FHIR-5439 is the ProcessRequest counterpart with the same request and resolution but was not independently decided. Zulip and Confluence searches found no directly relevant or conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current active FM resource set on the combined branch has both status elements and status search parameters, and the retired ProcessResponse source already reflects the historical status addition. Editing out-of-build ProcessResponse files or adding redundant prose would not change the current specification.
